name: Blueprint: cyanotype sheet, drafting order
for: how a machine, a pipeline or an architecture is built: parts drawn on, then exploded

motion.ease: lines draw on in drafting order; exploded views land on the beat
motion.note: cuts only on downbeats; one stamp colour, used once

avoid: subtitles at the bottom of the sheet
source: colour roles and type sizes after lemo-opuscar's blueprint notes (MIT); surface, muted and the stamp colour are ours
